content.comment_body: Hello, [url] I am considering getting a [product_name] Text Display, but I am a bit uncertain about compatibility. I have a 115-240V [product_name] with screen (version [version_no]) and wonder if I can connect it directly or if I need an additional power supply? Also, can I interact with my [product_name] module solely through the display, or is it just for viewing messages? Thanks.

The [product_name] Text Display requires a 24 V AC or DC power supply. This display is compatible with [product_name] modules operating at 12, 24, and 230 Volts. The display features four cursor keys, an ESC key, and an OK key, functioning like those on the main module. It also includes four function keys, labeled F1 to F4, which are available only on the display screen and not on the core module.
Hi [user_name], You can find more information about the [product_name] Text Display at [url].
Thank you for your help, everyone.

Important note: Hello [user_name]! You can use the Text Display to perform all functions available on the main [product_name] module except for programming or editing existing programs. You can start or stop the module (these functions can be password-protected), change parameters (which can also be restricted by protection settings in program blocks), and use the four function keys as inputs within your program. It's possible to create navigation menus for multiple screens and use the function keys to input values, toggle switches, and more.
Hi, Thanks for the clarification! Not being able to change parameters shouldn’t be an issue for our use-case. Planning to order it and start designing some custom menus soon. Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to expand their [product_name] setup with a Text Display but have questions about power requirements and the capabilities of the display, especially regarding control functions and programming. Replies clarify the need for a separate 24V power supply, describe the available navigation and input keys, and explain that programming or editing via the display is not possible, though parameter adjustments and control actions are supported.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the Text Display to provide direct interaction with their [product_name] module, ideally allowing for programming and parameter changes, and hope it will connect seamlessly without extra power requirements.
